spec.description: Season-boundary audit on v7.5 (full pool, seven layers, created entries, per-depth cavern casts): lake, ocean and brook forts, spring -> summer -> autumn (two changes, 2,000 ticks past the second), 1 replicate, DF restarted for every cell. The forts' saved v7.4 casts are rebuilt on the seven layers at load, which creates the population entries for cast species DF never stocked. Measured as X3, plus: cavern arrivals against their own depth's cast, and arrivals drawn from the tool's created entries. Passes with 0 off-cast arrivals later than one day after a change, 0 in-cast trims, every dismissed group off the map within 10 days, and 0 cavern arrivals at a depth their species is not cast at later than one day after a change.
spec.needs: sw-wt/plugin v7.5-fullpool 7dcf83b deployed; backups from X0
